title: Campaign 33 token C1_IDEAL (class 1): IR-L0, NAT-O0, IBM-U/T0/T3 exactness vs the exact Krylov states; noiseless sampling at the f=0.10 plan and 2e5 per sector; the f=1 SKQD reference

criteria.name: P1 max |dpsi| < 1e-10 and leakage < 1e-9 on every circuit of every allowed family
P2 per-state 5 sigma test |n_s/N - p_s| <= 5 sqrt(p_s(1-p_s)/N), p_s >= 1e-3, every sampled circuit
P3 noiseless SKQD at the f = 0.10 plan: recall of S999 >= 0.9 in both sectors
P3 E0 inside the Kato-Temple (B=0) / Weinstein (B=1) interval at the plan; E_R >= E0 - 1e-9
S1 the run happened on the requested device (GPU under the CI)
S2 wall time inside the walltime budget
criteria.threshold: <= min(walltime 1800 s, 3600 s) and <= 1.1 x budget + 120 s

criteria.name: S3 telemetry and run block present (policy fields non-null on the CI)
criteria.threshold: every policy field non-null on the CI; present on the laptop

criteria.name: S4 every seed and every chunk recorded
S5 no out-of-memory retry left unrecorded

data.content: IR-L0, NAT-O0, IBM-U/T0/T3 exactness vs the exact Krylov states; noiseless sampling at the f=0.10 plan and 2e5 per sector; the f=1 SKQD reference

seeds.rule: aer seed of chunk i of circuit c = s0 * 1e4 + c * 1e6 + i * stride, stride = chunk size, s0 = 33 000 000 + 1e5 x token index (prompts/33 2.3 s0; the circuit/chunk offsets are widened from 1e3 c so that circuits, chunks, tokens and the a/b halves are disjoint for <= 1e6 shots per circuit: the literal s0 + 1e3 c + i stride overlaps above 1000 shots per circuit)
